title: Salvies Better Emeralds
description: This is a mod that adds more use to emeralds outside of trading with villagers
body:
A mod that makes emeralds useful outside of trading with villagers.

# Why should u add this mod?

Cause emeralds are boring this days, who has fun trapping villagers in cells and praying to get what u want. This mod adds new tools and armor made out of emeralds. Each of these new items have different custom abilities that may help u in the end game while not being as much broken at the same time.
An example is the pickaxe, diging a starr shape with a radius of 3 block, or a **radiation staff** that poison other entities.

Not only that, but this mod adds:

**New food items**

**Chairs**

**And a custom villager, that trades new custom enchantments**

_credits to Kaupenjoe for making some of the textures and models_
